unit_of_observation: one fictional adult eligible for hypertension coaching at one community clinic
unit_of_assignment: none; coaching participation is voluntary and observational
exposure_mechanism: eligible adults decide whether to join; participation depends on measured baseline characteristics and latent health engagement
target_estimand: average 12-week difference in systolic blood pressure if every eligible adult in the fictional clinic cohort joined coaching versus if none joined
warning: This simulation is not a validated model of hypertension or health behavior. Standardization and weighting balance only measured covariates; a pre-exposure negative-control association is retained to show that residual confounding remains plausible.
causal_structure: age, baseline systolic blood pressure, smoking, medication, transport barrier, and clinic precede participation
measured baseline covariates affect both coaching participation and follow-up systolic blood pressure
latent health engagement affects participation, prior preventive visits, and follow-up systolic blood pressure
coaching participation affects follow-up systolic blood pressure
prior-year preventive visits precede participation and serve as a negative-control outcome

structural_equations.joined_coaching: Bernoulli(logit_inverse(-0.45 + measured baseline terms + clinic terms + 0.78*latent health engagement))
structural_equations.prior_year_preventive_visits: bounded continuous score driven by latent health engagement, medication, transport, clinic, and noise
structural_equations.followup_sbp: baseline and clinic terms - 2.2*latent health engagement + coaching effect that varies with baseline SBP + N(0,6.8^2)

missing_value_code: none; all ten fields are complete

variables.name: clinic
variables.role: pre-exposure clinic context and measured adjustment variable

variables.name: baseline_sbp
variables.role: measured pre-exposure confounder and effect-modification term

variables.name: transport_barrier
variables.role: measured pre-exposure confounder and participation constraint

variables.name: prior_year_preventive_visits
variables.role: pre-exposure negative-control outcome and proxy for health engagement

site_or_time_variables: three fictional clinics; prior year, baseline, time zero, and 12-week follow-up
